reliability_note: The canonical trial-vs-steady-state trap in this dossier. The advertised €4.17 is a first-term promotional rate on a 24-month commit; the renewal is €8.35 — a 2× step-up. Their own billing cart shows the undiscounted €11.99 monthly rate.
